source: Installed YMCC/Steam logs and read-only CDP observations

timeline.event: three ResizeObserver null-window errors and one getComputedStyle null-window error; Steam initialization
YMCC frontend loaded and mirror reconnected
Loader started after explicit Steam link admission

failure: Historical Steam page rebuild produced null-window frontend errors. The old installed host can start official Loader in an already loaded document.

attribution.proven: The locked official create_inject_script schedules RestartJSContext after 100ms if deckyHasLoaded is truthy. The production native admission and actual-target launch expression now reject that document.
attribution.unproven: Historical errors have no stack trace; repeated Loader injection cannot be asserted as their unique cause. The regression proves prevention of the known JS-context restart trigger, not reproduction or elimination of every null-window error.

expected: Update/manual/retry grants never start a second Loader in a loaded document; last-moment actual-target guard must reject a stale fresh snapshot. No automatic Steam restart/mode change. Recovery waits for a naturally fresh context; user/safety OFF wins. Network/store/plugin errors do not globally disable Decky.

greyPanelFollowup.visibleState: Performance and frame status waiting; controls disabled because no broker snapshot
greyPanelFollowup.remainingFix: Exact same active module + official version may rebind authenticated YMCC transport only; never invoke official Loader entry, start a Loader process or replay edits. Module/version mismatch and OFF remain rejected.

bigPictureReentry.fixtureProvenGap: Stale native slider change/begin/release callbacks retained authority after hide/reentry or Content replacement
bigPictureReentry.regressionFailure: a late slider change from the previous Big Picture page cannot enqueue an edit after reentry
bigPictureReentry.fix: Invalidate the per-Content interaction token on visibility changes and unmount; guard begin/change/end independently

fixtureReproduced: mounting inactive Content clears another active Content snapshot
hiding or unmounting one page cancels another page shared performance draft or in-flight request
fixes: MirrorClient aggregates visible Content owners; only the last hidden owner pauses snapshots
Each Content owns its performance/fan drafts and cancels only its own queues
Module dismount disposes all still-active page queues and clears visibility owners
